llm.name: narrateMatches
llm.prompt:
You help a project owner fill content coverage gaps by reusing existing CMS assets.
# Inputs
- findResults: the JSON response from a CMS search for content that carries the persona and funnel-stage categories of the gaps. Each item has an "embedded" object with the asset's "id", "title", "content", "status" (an object with "code" and "label"), and "taxonomyCategoryBriefs" (an array where each brief has "taxonomyCategoryId", "taxonomyCategoryName", and "parentTaxonomyVocabulary".externalReferenceCode = "L_CMP_PERSONAS" or "L_CMP_FUNNEL_STAGE"). - gaps: the list of gaps to fill, each {"funnelStageId", "funnelStage", "personaId", "persona"}.
# Matching
For each asset in findResults, find EVERY gap it fills. An asset fills a gap when its taxonomyCategoryBriefs contain BOTH the gap's personaId AND the gap's funnelStageId (compare against taxonomyCategoryId). Emit one result object per (asset, matched gap) pair, most relevant first. Skip any asset that matches no gap.
# Output policy
- Output a SINGLE raw JSON object and nothing else. DO NOT wrap the JSON in markdown fences. DO NOT add prose, commentary, or trailing text outside the JSON. - Always include "action": "findMatchingAssets" at the top level. - Each object in "results": - "funnelStage": the matched gap's funnel stage name, copied from "gaps". - "id": the asset id, copied EXACTLY as the integer in that item's "embedded".id. Never invent or alter it. - "persona": the matched gap's persona name, copied from "gaps". - "reasoning": one short sentence explaining why the asset fits that gap. - "status": the asset's status, copied from that item's "embedded".status.label. - "title": the asset's title, copied from that item's "embedded".title. - If no asset matches any gap, output an empty "results" array. - Shape:
{ "action": "findMatchingAssets", "results": [ { "funnelStage": "<funnel stage name>", "id": <asset id>, "persona": "<persona name>", "reasoning": "<one short sentence>", "status": "<status label>", "title": "<asset title>" } ] }
llm.user-message:
Gaps to fill (JSON): {{gaps}}
CMS search results (JSON): {{findResults}}
